operations.description: Gate the whole reduction on the control-word check of operand a2: ((dword at a2+6) ^ 0x700) & 0x700 == 0 identifies a valid 80-bit long-double pattern.
Index the classification table byte_5E74FC at ((xored control word >> 11) & 0xF); a non-zero entry admits the operand to the reduction path.
Exponent-class guards: skip when a2's exponent field (mask 0x7FFF0000) equals 0x7FFF0000 (infinity/NaN pattern), or when a5's exponent field is 0 or equals 0x7FFF0000 (also written 2147418112).
Skip when either operand's low doubleword of the mantissa (2 * DWORD1) is zero, marking an exact class that needs no reduction.
Branch on the exponent gap: if (a5 exponent, 0x7FFF mask) is greater than (a2 exponent, 0x7FFF mask) + 63 take the scaled-subtraction path, otherwise take the direct FPREM path.

Scaled-subtraction path: compute the iteration count from the exponent-byte difference (((expByte(a5) - expByte(a2)) & 0x3F | 0x20) + 1), then repeatedly subtract fabs(a2) from fabs(a5) while the FPU condition word lacks 0x100, scaling the divisor by dbl_5E752C each step until the count expires.
Direct path: while (a5 exponent, 0x7FFF mask) minus ((a2 exponent, 0x7FFF mask) + 10) is not negative, overwrite a5 with __FPREM__(a5, a2).
Reached from DoublePrecisionFloatClassification (0x00591574), consistent with an IEEE-754 remainder helper used by the classification path.
When the a1 flag has low bits set ((a1 & 3) != 0), reload the x87 floating-point environment (fnstenv/fldenv) so the caller observes the FPU status word.
Return the accumulated FPU status/condition value result.
